final_message:
Built the high sensitivity PubMed draft and saved the single line query to [final_strategy.txt](/C:/Users/aaron/AppData/Local/Temp/psb-evals/run-bb18548fe89ff8fd/ours-codex-noseed-20260927T102549Z/final_strategy.txt). The search requires Wilson disease and anticopper therapy; comparators, outcomes, and study design are assessed during screening.

With the 2018-12-23 cutoff, PubMed returned 4,062 records. The query retrieved all 7 screened development records, but there was no independent validation set, so this does not establish sensitivity. Two internal PRESS-structured critiques found no issues. The draft still needs PRESS peer review by an information specialist before use.

The full strategy, counts, assumptions, and audit are in [audit.md](/C:/Users/aaron/AppData/Local/Temp/psb-evals/run-bb18548fe89ff8fd/ours-codex-noseed-20260927T102549Z/work/audit.md).
